caveat_en: Display-only and lighter than the US read: HK has no leading Risk Radar, no VIX term structure (VHSI stands in), and the downturn gauges are uncalibrated. HK is heavily globally driven — US/EM beta and the HKD peg. Context, not a forecast.
caveat_zh: 仅供展示，较美股版更轻量：港股没有领先的风险雷达、没有 VIX 期限结构（以 VHSI 替代），下行指标未经校准。港股高度受全球驱动 — 美股／新兴市场贝塔与港元联汇。是背景，而非预测。
